fullText.simplified:
官渡之战（二）

    元少不相信许右。许右很生气，他想了想，拿着信去了曹操那儿。
    曹操看到许右手上拿着的信，他非常害怕。如果被元少发现他没有粮食了，那他马上就要败了。但是过了一会儿，曹操就高兴地笑了，因为许右是来帮他的，许右给曹操想了个好办法。
    许右说，虽然元少的军队多，但是都不厉害，如果粮食没有了，他的军队马上就会败。许右告诉曹操，元少的粮食都放在一个离官渡很近的地方，那儿的军队很少……
    曹操很高兴，问他：“你为什么帮我？”
    许右说：“我为元少工作很多年了，但他总是觉得我不聪明，一直都不相信我，我不想再为他工作了。”
    虽然曹操也不相信许右，但是如果许右说的是真的，那曹操就能打败元少了。曹操想试一下。晚上，他带着军队出去了。很快曹操就发现，许右说的是真的！他找到了元少的粮食！
    曹操太高兴了，他让军队放了火，把粮食都烧了……
    放完火，烧完粮食，曹操马上带着军队去打元少。
    元少的军队看到火，知道粮食被烧了，都非常害怕，又看到曹操的军队打过来了，就更害怕了。没有粮食，那怎么打仗？有些人马上就不想打了，说要去曹操那儿为曹操工作。还有人不想帮曹操，但是也不想死，就往北方跑了。
    元少的人越来越少，他很快就败了。
fullText.traditional:
官渡之戰（二）

    元少不相信許右。許右很生氣，他想了想，拿著信去了曹操那兒。
    曹操看到許右手上拿著的信，他非常害怕。如果被元少發現他沒有糧食了，那他馬上就要敗了。但是過了一會兒，曹操就高興地笑了，因為許右是來幫他的，許右給曹操想了個好辦法。
    許右說，雖然元少的軍隊多，但是都不厲害，如果糧食沒有了，他的軍隊馬上就會敗。許右告訴曹操，元少的糧食都放在一個離官渡很近的地方，那兒的軍隊很少……
    曹操很高興，問他：“你為什麼幫我？”
    許右說：“我為元少工作很多年了，但他總是覺得我不聰明，一直都不相信我，我不想再為他工作了。”
    雖然曹操也不相信許右，但是如果許右說的是真的，那曹操就能打敗元少了。曹操想試一下。晚上，他帶著軍隊出去了。很快曹操就發現，許右說的是真的！他找到了元少的糧食！
    曹操太高興了，他讓軍隊放了火，把糧食都燒了……
    放完火，燒完糧食，曹操馬上帶著軍隊去打元少。
    元少的軍隊看到火，知道糧食被燒了，都非常害怕，又看到曹操的軍隊打過來了，就更害怕了。沒有糧食，那怎麼打仗？有些人馬上就不想打了，說要去曹操那兒為曹操工作。還有人不想幫曹操，但是也不想死，就往北方跑了。
    元少的人越來越少，他很快就敗了。

sentences.simplified: 元少不相信许右。许右很生气，他想了想，拿着信去了曹操那儿。
sentences.traditional: 元少不相信許右。許右很生氣，他想了想，拿著信去了曹操那兒。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào bù xiāng xìn xǔ yòu xǔ yòu hěn shēng qì tā xiǎng le xiǎng ná zhe xìn qù le cáo cāo nà'r
sentences.english: Yuan Shao didn’t believe Xu You. Xu You was very angry. He thought about it and took the letter to Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 曹操看到许右手上拿着的信，他非常害怕。
sentences.traditional: 曹操看到許右手上拿著的信，他非常害怕。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo kàn dào xǔ yòu shǒu shang ná zhe de xìn tā fēi cháng hài pà
sentences.english: Cao Cao was very scared when he saw the letter in Xu You’s hand.

sentences.simplified: 如果被元少发现他没有粮食了，那他马上就要败了。
sentences.traditional: 如果被元少發現他沒有糧食了，那他馬上就要敗了。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ bèi yuán shào fā xiàn tā méi yǒu liáng shi le nà tā mǎ shàng jiù yào bài le
sentences.english: If Yuan Shao found out that he had no more grain, then he would lose immediately.

sentences.simplified: 但是过了一会儿，曹操就高兴地笑了，
sentences.traditional: 但是過了一會兒，曹操就高興地笑了，
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì guò le yí huì'r cáo cāo jiù gāo xìng de xiào le
sentences.english: But after a while, Cao Cao was smiling happily.

sentences.simplified: 因为许右是来帮他的，许右给曹操想了个好办法。
sentences.traditional: 因為許右是來幫他的，許右給曹操想了個好辦法。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi xǔ yòu shì lái bāng tā de xǔ yòu gěi cáo cāo xiǎng le ge hǎo bàn fǎ
sentences.english: Because Xu You was there to help him, and Xu You had thought of a good solution for Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 许右说，虽然元少的军队多，但是都不厉害，
sentences.traditional: 許右說，雖然元少的軍隊多，但是都不厲害，
sentences.pinyin: xǔ yòu shuō suī rán yuán shào de jūn duì duō dàn shì dōu bú lì hai
sentences.english: Xu You said that although Yuan Shao had many troops, they were not very formidable.

sentences.simplified: 如果粮食没有了，他的军队马上就会败。
sentences.traditional: 如果糧食沒有了，他的軍隊馬上就會敗。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ liáng shi méi yǒu le tā de jūn duì mǎ shàng jiù huì bài
sentences.english: If there was no grain, his troops would be defeated immediately.

sentences.simplified: 许右告诉曹操，元少的粮食都放在一个离官渡很近的地方，那儿的军队很少……
sentences.traditional: 許右告訴曹操，元少的糧食都放在一個離官渡很近的地方，那兒的軍隊很少……
sentences.pinyin: xǔ yòu gào su cáo cāo yuán shào de liáng shi dōu fàng zài yí ge lí guān dù hěn jìn de dì fang nà'r de jūn duì hěn shǎo
sentences.english: Xu You told Cao Cao that all of Yuan Shao’s grain was kept close to Guandu and that there were very few troops there …

sentences.simplified: 曹操很高兴，问他：“你为什么帮我？”
sentences.traditional: 曹操很高興，問他：“你為什麼幫我？”
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo hěn gāo xìng wèn tā nǐ wèi shén me bāng wǒ
sentences.english: Cao Cao was very happy and asked him, “Why are you helping me?”

sentences.simplified: 许右说：“我为元少工作很多年了，
sentences.traditional: 許右說：“我為元少工作很多年了，
sentences.pinyin: xǔ yòu shuō wǒ wèi yuán shào gōng zuò hěn duō nián le
sentences.english: Xu You said, “I have worked for Yuan Shao for many years.

sentences.simplified: 但他总是觉得我不聪明，一直都不相信我，我不想再为他工作了。”
sentences.traditional: 但他總是覺得我不聰明，一直都不相信我，我不想再為他工作了。”
sentences.pinyin: dàn tā zǒng shì jué de wǒ bù cōng ming yì zhí dōu bù xiāng xìn wǒ wǒ bù xiǎng zài wèi tā gōng zuò le
sentences.english: But he always thinks that I am not smart and has never believed me. I don’t want to work for him anymore.”

sentences.simplified: 虽然曹操也不相信许右，
sentences.traditional: 雖然曹操也不相信許右，
sentences.pinyin: suī rán cáo cāo yě bù xiāng xìn xǔ yòu
sentences.english: Although Cao Cao didn’t believe Xu You either, ..

sentences.simplified: 但是如果许右说的是真的，那曹操就能打败元少了。
sentences.traditional: 但是如果許右說的是真的，那曹操就能打敗元少了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì rú guǒ xǔ yòu shuō de shì zhēn de nà cáo cāo jiù néng dǎ bài yuán shào le
sentences.english: .. if what Xu You said was true, then Cao Cao would be able to defeat Yuan Shao.

sentences.simplified: 曹操想试一下。晚上，他带着军队出去了。
sentences.traditional: 曹操想試一下。晚上，他帶著軍隊出去了。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo xiǎng shì yí xià wǎn shang tā dài zhe jūn duì chū qù le
sentences.english: Cao Cao wanted to give it a try. At night, he brought out his troops.

sentences.simplified: 很快曹操就发现，许右说的是真的！他找到了元少的粮食！
sentences.traditional: 很快曹操就發現，許右說的是真的！他找到了元少的糧食！
sentences.pinyin: hěn kuài cáo cāo jiù fā xiàn xǔ yòu shuō de shì zhēn de tā zhǎo dào le yuán shào de liáng shi
sentences.english: Cao Cao discovered very quickly that what Xu You said was true! He found Yuan Shao’s grain!

sentences.simplified: 曹操太高兴了，他让军队放了火，把粮食都烧了……
sentences.traditional: 曹操太高興了，他讓軍隊放了火，把糧食都燒了……
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo tài gāo xìng le tā ràng jūn duì fàng le huǒ bǎ liáng shi dōu shāo le
sentences.english: Cao Cao was so happy. He made his troops start a fire and burned all the grain …

sentences.simplified: 放完火，烧完粮食，曹操马上带着军队去打元少。
sentences.traditional: 放完火，燒完糧食，曹操馬上帶著軍隊去打元少。
sentences.pinyin: fàng wán huǒ shāo wán liáng shi cáo cāo mǎ shàng dài zhe jūn duì qù dǎ yuán shào
sentences.english: After they started the fire and burned all the grain, Cao Cao immediately led the troops to fight against Yuan Shao.

sentences.simplified: 元少的军队看到火，知道粮食被烧了，都非常害怕，
sentences.traditional: 元少的軍隊看到火，知道糧食被燒了，都非常害怕，
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào de jūn duì kàn dào huǒ zhī dào liáng shi bèi shāo le dōu fēi cháng hài pà
sentences.english: Yuan Shao’s troops were very afraid when they saw the fire and knew that the grain had been burned.

sentences.simplified: 又看到曹操的军队打过来了，就更害怕了。
sentences.traditional: 又看到曹操的軍隊打過來了，就更害怕了。
sentences.pinyin: yòu kàn dào cáo cāo de jūn duì dǎ guò lái le jiù gèng hài pà le
sentences.english: When they saw Cao Cao’s troops coming to fight them, they became even more afraid.

sentences.simplified: 没有粮食，那怎么打仗？
sentences.traditional: 沒有糧食，那怎麼打仗？
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu liáng shi nà zěn me dǎ zhàng
sentences.english: How could they fight a battle without grain?

sentences.simplified: 有些人马上就不想打了，说要去曹操那儿为曹操工作。
sentences.traditional: 有些人馬上就不想打了，說要去曹操那兒為曹操工作。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu xiē rén mǎ shàng jiù bù xiǎng dǎ le shuō yào qù cáo cāo nà'r wèi cáo cāo gōng zuò
sentences.english: Some people didn’t want to fight right away, saying that they were going over to Cao Cao to work for Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 还有人不想帮曹操，但是也不想死，就往北方跑了。
sentences.traditional: 還有人不想幫曹操，但是也不想死，就往北方跑了。
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu rén bù xiǎng bāng cáo cāo dàn shì yě bù xiǎng sǐ jiù wǎng běi fāng pǎo le
sentences.english: Other people didn’t want to help Cao Cao, but they didn’t want to die either, so they ran north.

sentences.simplified: 元少的人越来越少，他很快就败了。
sentences.traditional: 元少的人越來越少，他很快就敗了。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào de rén yuè lái yuè shǎo tā hěn kuài jiù bài le
sentences.english: Yuan Shao had fewer and fewer men, and he was quickly defeated.

sentence_translations: The Battle of Guandu (2)
Yuan Shao didn’t believe Xu You. Xu You was very angry. He thought about it and took the letter to Cao Cao.
Cao Cao was very scared when he saw the letter in Xu You’s hand.
If Yuan Shao found out that he had no more grain, then he would lose immediately.
But after a while, Cao Cao was smiling happily.
Because Xu You was there to help him, and Xu You had thought of a good solution for Cao Cao.
Xu You said that although Yuan Shao had many troops, they were not very formidable.
If there was no grain, his troops would be defeated immediately.
Xu You told Cao Cao that all of Yuan Shao’s grain was kept close to Guandu and that there were very few troops there …
Cao Cao was very happy and asked him, “Why are you helping me?”
Xu You said, “I have worked for Yuan Shao for many years.
But he always thinks that I am not smart and has never believed me. I don’t want to work for him anymore.”
Although Cao Cao didn’t believe Xu You either, ..
.. if what Xu You said was true, then Cao Cao would be able to defeat Yuan Shao.
Cao Cao wanted to give it a try. At night, he brought out his troops.
Cao Cao discovered very quickly that what Xu You said was true! He found Yuan Shao’s grain!
Cao Cao was so happy. He made his troops start a fire and burned all the grain …
After they started the fire and burned all the grain, Cao Cao immediately led the troops to fight against Yuan Shao.
Yuan Shao’s troops were very afraid when they saw the fire and knew that the grain had been burned.
When they saw Cao Cao’s troops coming to fight them, they became even more afraid.
How could they fight a battle without grain?
Some people didn’t want to fight right away, saying that they were going over to Cao Cao to work for Cao Cao.
Other people didn’t want to help Cao Cao, but they didn’t want to die either, so they ran north.
Yuan Shao had fewer and fewer men, and he was quickly defeated.
